data.module_description: Superset集成配置与容器化部署脚本，提供开箱即用的BI数据可视化与多维报表展示，并通过Trino连接底层数据源。
data.interaction: The container exposes standard Superset web interfaces and connects externally to Trino data sources via the installed SQLAlchemy driver for executing queries and fetching multidimensional datasets.
data.implementation: The module uses Docker containerization via a custom Dockerfile that extends the official Apache Superset image (apache/superset:6.1.0). It elevates privileges to root to install the Trino SQLAlchemy connector (trino[sqlalchemy]==0.339.0) using uv pip, ensuring reliable connectivity to Trino data sources for multi-dimensional reporting and BI visualization.

graph TD
    A[Superset Container Build] -->|Extends apache/superset:6.1.0| B(Root User Setup)
    B -->|Install Dependencies| C[Install trino[sqlalchemy]==0.339.0]

sequenceDiagram
